identity.name: KAIO Brevan Howard Master Fund Access (MACROx)

about.description: MACROx is a tokenized feeder share class of Libre SAF VCC (Singapore) providing access to the Brevan Howard Master Fund's global macro strategy, issued via the KAIO (ex-Libre) protocol for accredited and institutional investors with monthly liquidity and NAV-based pricing. Only the current Ethereum register is tracked: a legacy duplicate register (0x340f2f4f..) exists with mirrored mint amounts, and platform escrow proxies are excluded from active supply. The on-chain NAV entry was last updated 2025-05-30.
about.registryInfo: Brevan Howard Master Fund is referenced as an institutional fund tokenized via KAIO in public announcements tied to KAIO’s network integrations.
